{{Short description|Group in group theory mathematics}}
In [[mathematics]], in the field of [[group theory]], an '''FC-group''' is a [[group (mathematics)|group]] in which every [[conjugacy class]] of elements has finite [[cardinality]].

The following are some facts about FC-groups:

* Every [[finite group]] is an FC-group.<ref>{{harvtxt|Scott|1987}}, 15.1.1, p. 441.</ref>
* Every [[abelian group]] is an FC-group.<ref>{{harvtxt|Scott|1987}}, 15.1.2, p. 441.</ref>
* The following property is stronger than the property of being FC: every [[subgroup]] has finite index in its [[Normal closure (group theory)|normal closure]].
